newsitem.title: UK: BFI up three but market fragile.
newsitem.headline: BFI up three but market fragile.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up three points on Thursday to 1,291 points.

With the small exception of Capers which have recently influenced the BFI in a positive direction, brokers believed that the freight market was fundamentally lacking in strength and continued fragile.
Panamax and Handy-size rates appeared to be under pressure in most areas, they said.
The Baltic Handy Index was down 11 to 1,071 points reflecting softer timecharter rates worldwide but in particular in the Continent/Far East trade, brokers said.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was five to 15 points down and turnover totalled 34 lots.
